title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) Heersink School of Medicine
Department: Division of Hematology and Oncology
Deadline: ERAS; interviews generally August-September; Match Day in December
Eligibility: Eligible for Alabama medical licence and controlled-substance certificate (all USMLE steps completed at time of application); eligible for federal DEA registration; valid ECFMG certificate for IMGs; three letters of recommendation
International applicants: IMGs accepted with a valid ECFMG Standard Certificate (programme page)
Application method: ERAS; the Match; signalling used (signals preferentially reviewed)
Visa support: Division page: sponsors J-1 visas; H-1B only if the fellow is currently within the US. Apply page: 'This program sponsors J-1 and H-1B visas' (programme pages)
Licence requirement: Valid unrestricted Alabama medical licence, Alabama Controlled Substance Certificate and federal DEA certificate before starting
Summary: A comprehensive three-year haematology and oncology fellowship at UAB offering hands-on clinical training across benign and malignant haematology and solid tumours with a multidisciplinary approach.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship Training Program
inst: University of Arizona Cancer Center / College of Medicine - Tucson
Department: Division of Hematology and Oncology, University of Arizona Cancer Center
Eligibility: Completion of a US ABIM-accredited internal medicine residency; ABIM eligibility for the internal medicine certifying exam before fellowship starts
International applicants: Non-US citizens must hold a US visa permitting at least three additional years of training (programme page)
Application method: ERAS; haematology and medical oncology fellowship match
Visa support: Programme has 'occasionally supported an H1-B visa applicant for a truly extraordinary candidate' (e.g. MD-PhD with matching research) (programme page)
Summary: A traditional ABIM-accredited three-year subspecialty programme preparing internists for board certification in haematology and medical oncology, with an integrative medicine in haematology/oncology option run with Mayo Clinic Arizona.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences (UAMS)
Department: Department of Internal Medicine, Division of Hematology/Oncology
Positions: 15 fellows in total (5 per year implied by three-year programme; page states 'our fifteen fellows')
Summary: A three-year programme at UAMS training fifteen fellows to become leading oncologists and haematologists with an emphasis on compassionate patient care.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: Scripps Clinic / Scripps Green Hospital
Department: Scripps Graduate Medical Education
Deadline: Completed applications due 15 August; virtual interviews September-October
Funding: Standardised compensation package with base salary inclusive of housing stipend, health insurance, educational allowance and paid leave
Visa support: Scripps Clinic does not sponsor J-1 or H-1 visas (programme page)
Summary: A three-year ACGME-accredited, outpatient-focused haematology and medical oncology fellowship across Scripps Green Hospital and Scripps Mercy Hospital San Diego with BMT, acute leukaemia and palliative care rotations.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: Loma Linda University Health Education Consortium
Department: Loma Linda University Medical Center Graduate Medical Education
Summary: A three-year ACGME-accredited programme across Loma Linda University Medical Center, the Pettis VA and Riverside University Health System covering solid tumours, haematologic malignancies, benign haematology and cellular therapy.

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship
inst: Sutter Roseville Medical Center (Sutter Health)
Department: Sutter Health Graduate Medical Education
Eligibility: USMLE Steps 1-3 (or COMLEX 1-3); graduate of LCME/COCA-accredited school or ECFMG-evaluated foreign school; work authorisation at application and throughout training
International applicants: IMGs eligible if work-authorised; EAD considered (programme page)
Application method: ERAS; the Match (all positions filled through the Match)
Visa support: Sutter Health does not sponsor J-1, H-1B or other visas; Employment Authorization Document considered (programme page)
Summary: A new 36-month ACGME-accredited haematology and medical oncology fellowship based at Sutter Roseville with bone marrow transplant rotations at Sutter Medical Center Sacramento.

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship
inst: Kaiser Permanente Northern California (San Francisco)
Department: Kaiser Permanente Northern California Graduate Medical Education
Deadline: ERAS submission begins in July; interviews September-October
Summary: A 36-month ACGME-accredited fellowship at Kaiser Permanente San Francisco with leukaemia/lymphoma training at KP Santa Clara and cellular therapy/BMT at Stanford, emphasising value-based integrated care.

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship
inst: Sutter Health California Pacific Medical Center (CPMC)
Department: Sutter Health Graduate Medical Education
Summary: A small 36-month ACGME-accredited fellowship taking one fellow a year, with outpatient training at CPMC and inpatient malignant haematology/BMT rotations at UCSF.

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: UC Davis Health
Department: Department of Internal Medicine, Division of Hematology and Oncology
Application method: ERAS (select Hematology-Focused Track in ERAS for that track)
Positions: ACGME-approved for 13 positions; for 2026-2027 planning 3 combined haematology/oncology fellows and 1 Hematology-Focused track fellow
Funding: Hematology-Focused track: $5,000/year visiting rotation, $1,000/year ASH meeting and $1,500/year scholarly research stipends
Summary: A three-year programme meeting board requirements in haematology and oncology with clinical, education or research tracks and a Hematology Focused Fellowship Track.

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship
inst: UCSF Fresno
Department: UCSF Fresno Department of Internal Medicine
Funding: Salary and benefits per UCSF Fresno schedule (https://fresno.ucsf.edu/Salary-and-benefits)
Summary: Founded in 2016, a fellowship training haematologist-oncologists at Community Regional Medical Center, Community Cancer Institute, the Central California VA and UCSF/Mount Zion.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: USA Health Mitchell Cancer Institute (University of South Alabama)
Department: Department of Internal Medicine, Mitchell Cancer Institute
International applicants: Not stated on official page; current fellows listed include graduates of international medical schools (programme page)
Summary: A fully integrated three-year ACGME-accredited programme at the Mitchell Cancer Institute with monthly subspecialty rotations and a stem cell transplant rotation at the University of Alabama.

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship
inst: UC Irvine School of Medicine (UCI Health Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center)
Department: Department of Medicine, Division of Hematology and Oncology
Eligibility: Completed a three-year ACGME/ABIM-recognised internal medicine residency; demonstrated interest in haematology/oncology
International applicants: Candidates must be US citizens or permanent residents, or hold a J-1 visa with ECFMG sponsorship at the time of application (programme page)
Funding: Per UCI residents and fellows salary schedule
Licence requirement: Valid California medical licence before starting (licensure for international graduates can take six months or longer)
Summary: An ACGME-approved three-year combined haematology/medical oncology programme at UCI Medical Center and the Tibor Rubin VA Long Beach leading to ABIM eligibility in both subspecialties.

title: Hematology Oncology Fellowship
inst: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus
Department: Division of Medical Oncology and Division of Hematology
Deadline: ERAS opens 15 July 2026; programme application deadline 31 August 2026; virtual interviews 11 September - 23 October 2026
Eligibility: Four letters of recommendation (incl. programme director), CV, MSPE, USMLE/COMLEX transcript, personal statement; foreign applicants also supply foreign medical licence and ECFMG status report
International applicants: Foreign medical graduates must provide foreign medical licence and ECFMG status report (programme page)
Application method: ERAS; Medical Specialties Matching Program; preference signals used as a critical screening tool
Summary: A three-year programme aiming to develop academic cancer medicine leaders, with first-year rotations at University of Colorado Hospital, Denver Health and the VA and research, clinical-excellence or BMT tracks thereafter.

title: Hematology & Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: Bayhealth Medical Center
Department: Bayhealth Cancer Institute / Graduate Medical Education
Summary: A community-based haematology-medical oncology fellowship at Bayhealth's Cancer Institute in central Delaware, a member of the Penn Cancer Network, training fellows in state-of-the-art care and research.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: ChristianaCare (Helen F. Graham Cancer Center & Research Institute)

Eligibility: Three years of accredited internal medicine residency in the US or Canada before starting; graduates of schools outside the US/Canada must be ECFMG-certified
International applicants: IMGs eligible with ECFMG certification (programme page)
Application method: ERAS only (non-ERAS applications not accepted); the Match
Summary: A fully ACGME-accredited three-year programme based at Christiana Hospital Newark and the Graham Cancer Center, which treats about 70% of new cancer diagnoses in Delaware.

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: George Washington University School of Medicine and Health Sciences
Department: Department of Medicine, Division of Hematology and Oncology
Eligibility: Three years of ACGME-accredited internal medicine residency; board certified or eligible; USMLE/COMLEX Steps I-III passed before start; ECFMG certification for IMGs
International applicants: IMGs considered only with J-1 visas and must have completed an ACGME-accredited residency (programme page)
Application method: ERAS only; the Match registration required
Visa support: J-1 only (per programme page and GW GME visa policy)
Summary: A well-rounded haematology and medical oncology fellowship at GW Hospital and the Washington VA Medical Center with an NIH research-training affiliation.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: Broward Health North
Department: Broward Health Graduate Medical Education
Summary: A three-year community-based fellowship at Broward Health North with inpatient and outpatient haematology/oncology consultation rotations and subspecialty electives, preparing fellows for community or academic careers.

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: University of Florida College of Medicine (Gainesville)
Department: Division of Hematology & Oncology
Summary: A comprehensive fellowship preparing board-certified haematologist-oncologists through care of diverse patients at UF Health and the Malcom Randall VA Medical Center.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: University of Florida College of Medicine - Jacksonville
Department: Department of Medicine, Division of Hematology and Medical Oncology
Summary: A three-year ACGME-accredited fellowship in the broad discipline of haematology and medical oncology offered by the UF Department of Medicine in Jacksonville.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: Florida International University Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine / Baptist Health South Florida

Summary: A new three-year intensive programme with an individualised approach, training fellows in malignant and benign haematology and solid tumour oncology across high-volume Baptist Health sites.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: AdventHealth Florida (Orlando)
Department: AdventHealth Graduate Medical Education

Summary: A three-year (PGY-4 to PGY-6) competency-based fellowship grounded in whole-person care, with consult, leukaemia/BMT-cellular therapy and community haematology/oncology rotations.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: Memorial Healthcare System (Hollywood, Florida)
Department: Memorial Healthcare System Graduate Medical Education
Summary: A community-based, university-affiliated (FAU/FIU) three-year ACGME-accredited programme, begun in 2021, combining community hospital and tertiary referral experience.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: HCA Florida Westside Hospital / Northwest Hospital
Department: HCA Healthcare Graduate Medical Education

Summary: An HCA Healthcare community-based haematology and medical oncology fellowship at Westside and Northwest hospitals in Broward County aimed at developing future physician leaders.

title: Hematology Oncology Fellowship
inst: Cleveland Clinic Florida (Weston)

International applicants: IMGs accepted with ECFMG certification at time of application (programme page)
Visa support: Sponsors J-1 and H-1B visas (programme page)
Summary: A three-year fellowship building a solid foundation in diagnosing and treating haematologic and oncologic disease, with required rotations in benign and malignant haematology and site-specific oncology.

title: Hematology & Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: Medical College of Georgia at Augusta University

Application method: ERAS; Medicine Subspecialty Match; programme participates in signalling
Visa support: Supports J-1 visa status only (programme page)
Summary: A combined three-year ACGME-accredited programme with clinician or clinical-investigator tracks, featuring a haemophilia treatment centre and an internationally recognised sickle cell centre.

title: Hematology & Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: University of Hawai'i John A. Burns School of Medicine (JABSOM)

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship
inst: Cook County Health (John H. Stroger, Jr. Hospital of Cook County)

title: Hematology-Oncology Fellowship Program

Summary: A three-year University of Chicago-sponsored fellowship at Endeavor Health NorthShore preparing clinicians for academic or community practice with clinical and translational research opportunities.

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship
inst: Loyola University Medical Center (Loyola Medicine)

Summary: A three-year ACGME-accredited haematology/oncology programme built on the depth of Loyola's clinical care and research, culminating in dual ABIM board eligibility.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: Chicago Medical School / Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science
Department: Chicago Medical School Graduate Medical Education
Summary: A three-year programme preparing trainees for clinical consultative practice and board eligibility in haematology and medical oncology.

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship
inst: Franciscan Health Olympia Fields
Department: Franciscan Health Graduate Medical Education
Summary: A three-year fully ACGME-accredited community programme training two fellows a year in an environment guided by Franciscan values.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: Advocate Lutheran General Hospital (Advocate Health)
Department: Department of Medicine
Summary: A three-year combined programme training clinical haematologists and oncologists with increasing responsibility in patient care, procedures, clinical research and quality improvement.

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship
inst: Olive View-UCLA Medical Center
Department: Department of Medicine, Division of Hematology/Oncology
Summary: A fully integrated three-year programme across Olive View-UCLA, Ronald Reagan UCLA and Kaiser Permanente Los Angeles covering haematology, oncology and stem cell transplantation.

title: Fellowship in Hematology and Medical Oncology
inst: Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (Los Angeles County DHS)
Department: Division of Hematology and Medical Oncology
Summary: A clinically and academically rigorous ACGME-accredited fellowship training clinicians, educators and investigators at Harbor-UCLA, Kaiser Permanente and City of Hope with a focus on underserved patients.

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship
inst: University of Kentucky College of Medicine (Markey Cancer Center)
Department: Department of Internal Medicine
Summary: A three-year ACGME-accredited programme serving patients from inner-city Lexington to underserved Appalachia, with six to twelve months of required research time.

title: Medical Oncology and Hematology Fellowship Program
inst: University of Louisville School of Medicine (UofL Health - Brown Cancer Center)

Summary: A reorganised and expanded three-year programme offering extensive clinical experience including TIL, CAR-T and bispecific immunotherapies, with strong faculty mentorship.

title: Hematology-Oncology Fellowship
inst: LSU Health Sciences Center New Orleans School of Medicine
Department: Department of Medicine, Hematology-Oncology Section
Summary: A three-year ACGME-accredited fellowship allowing board eligibility in haematology and medical oncology, focused on clinical training so fellows can practise with substantial independence.

title: Hematology & Medical Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: Ochsner Health (Ochsner Clinic Foundation)
Department: Ochsner Cancer Institute / Graduate Medical Education
Summary: A comprehensive three-year dual-specialty programme with mostly clinical training and 3-6 months of mentored research, preparing fellows for clinical practice, academic medicine or research.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
inst: Tulane University School of Medicine
Department: Department of Medicine, Section of Hematology and Medical Oncology
Application method: ERAS; the Match; applicants who signal are preferentially reviewed
Summary: A three-year programme providing comprehensive diagnosis and management experience in haematologic and oncologic disorders at East Jefferson General Hospital, University Medical Center and other sites.

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship
inst: LSU Health Shreveport (Feist-Weiller Cancer Center)

Application method: ERAS; the Match; signalling applicants may be preferentially considered
Summary: A three-year fully ACGME-accredited fellowship at the Feist-Weiller Cancer Center in Shreveport, described by its fellows as having a friendly, collegial learning culture.

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship
inst: MaineHealth Maine Medical Center
Department: MaineHealth Cancer Care / Graduate Medical Education
Summary: A three-year programme (first class 2023) requiring dual certification, with palliative, radiation and surgical oncology rotations, a grant-writing course and a second-year research immersion.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: Luminis Health Anne Arundel Medical Center
Department: Luminis Health Center for Cancer and Blood Disorders

Eligibility: Medical degree; ACGME-accredited internal medicine residency completed by enrolment; able to obtain Maryland and Delaware licences; passed USMLE or COMLEX; three letters of recommendation
Summary: A combined three-year programme preparing fellows for ABIM board eligibility in haematology and medical oncology, with rotations including TidalHealth Nanticoke in Delaware and an emphasis on rural oncology.

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship

Eligibility: Complete ERAS application including USMLE I, II and III scores
International applicants: Applications from qualified candidates holding visas will be considered, aligned with institutional and governmental policies (programme page)
Application method: ERAS (Traditional Hematology/Oncology Track and Hematology Track); the Match; gold/silver signals prioritised
Visa support: Visa holders considered per institutional policy; visa types not specified (programme page)

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship

Accreditation: ACGME-accredited (Tufts University School of Medicine affiliated)
Visa support: J-1 (copy required if applicable); H-1B not supported this academic year (programme page)
Summary: A Tufts-affiliated ACGME programme led by Dana-Farber faculty, training competent and compassionate haematologist-oncologists at Boston Medical Center - Brighton.

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship
inst: Lahey Hospital & Medical Center (Lahey Clinic)

title: Hematology-Oncology Fellowship

Visa support: May accept J-1 clinical visas; may sponsor H-1B in rare circumstances for an exceptional candidate (programme page)
Summary: A three-year ACGME-accredited haematology/oncology fellowship at UMass Chan Medical School in Worcester.

title: Hematology-Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: Dartmouth Cancer Center / Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center
Department: Dartmouth Cancer Center
Summary: Founded in 1960, a three-year programme at Northern New England's only NCI-designated comprehensive cancer centre spanning classical and malignant haematology, solid tumours, stem cell transplant and CAR-T.

title: Hematology/Medical Oncology Fellowship Program
inst: Main Line Health - Lankenau Medical Center
Department: Lankenau Institute / Main Line Health Graduate Medical Education
Eligibility: Three letters of recommendation (one from current programme director)
Application method: ERAS; signalled applications reviewed first; virtual interviews
Summary: A small 36-month ACGME-accredited fellowship at Lankenau Medical Center offering a personalised learning environment with no in-house overnight call.

title: Hematology & Oncology Fellowship
inst: Henry Ford Hospital (Henry Ford Health)
Department: Department of Hematology/Oncology
Summary: A haematology and medical oncology fellowship at Henry Ford Hospital in Detroit providing the training and experience needed to complete all requirements for subspecialty board eligibility.

Application method: ERAS only; the Match (ACGME programme ID 1552521126); virtual interviews
Visa support: Does not sponsor or accept visa candidates (programme page)
Summary: A community-academic three-year programme with rotations at McLaren Greater Lansing and Sparrow Hospital, didactics and research opportunities through Michigan State University.

title: Hematology and Oncology Fellowship
inst: Henry Ford Genesys Hospital

Summary: A three-year fellowship educating professionals in the care of patients with blood dyscrasias and malignancies, emphasising critical appraisal of literature and teaching.

Summary: A programme running for over twenty years with extensive clinical and research experience, rotations at Karmanos Cancer Center and an internationally recognised radiation oncology service.

title: Hematology/Oncology Fellowship Program

Summary: A community-medicine programme with strong academic ties whose fellows rotate through Providence Southfield and Novi hospitals and go on to academic, research and community careers.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship

Summary: A clinician-focused fellowship, begun in 2019 alongside a new cancer centre, integrating fellows into inpatient services, multidisciplinary tumour clinics and research.

title: Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship
